name: I Am Chaos Dog: Pet Simulator
summary: Step into the wild paws of a chaotic dog in I Am Chaos Dog: Pet Simulator! Explore an open world where you play as a mischievous dog causing fun, funny chaos everywhere. Run, jump, destroy, and interact with objects in a fully dynamic environment. Experience a unique dog simulator with sandbox freedom, entertaining pet game play, and endless chaos. Enjoy animal game fun with realistic controls, exciting missions, and nonstop action in a lively pet simulator world.
